newsitem.title: PERU: Buses, negotiators arrive at Peru residence.
newsitem.headline: Buses, negotiators arrive at Peru residence.

text.p: Several large buses pulled up outside the besieged Japanese embassy residence on Sunday night, accompanied by chief Peruvian government negotiator Domingo Palermo and top Red Cross mediator Michel Minnig.

Palermo's first visit to the compound where around 340 hostages were still being held by Marxists gunmen and the presence of the buses sparked speculation in local media that a development in the crisis was imminent but there was no official confirmation.
Police swarmed over the area trying to hold back waiting newsmen but there was no clear indication of what might be happening.
One of the buses appeared to have broken down and television pictures showed its driver pulling at its gearstick in frustration.
Large numbers of firemen also congregated in the area outside the residence.
There have been no major developments at the residence since a group of 38 hostages were released on Friday night.
